data.description:
The ultimate VR Golf experience and the official VR Golf game of the PGA TOUR!

“The GOLF+ VR platform is a forward-thinking way to enjoy the sport that is appealing to gamers and golfers of all levels.” - PGA TOUR

{491205557214219}

“The visuals are fantastic. It’s like morphing into another universe filled with vibrancy, dynamism and, most important, realism.” - Sports Illustrated

“The putting function — which simulator golf has never quite cracked — is particularly eye-opening.” - GOLF Magazine

# Includes:

⛳️ Iconic Courses: 3 Free Courses and 25+ real-world destinations available for purchase including Pebble Beach, The Old Course at St Andrews, TPC Sawgrass and more.
{7874775169289873}

🏌️Multiplayer: Play with your circle of friends, or join public rounds and connect with golf enthusiasts worldwide.

{2016191868794782}

🏆 Competitive Play: Climb the ranks and compete globally on the GOLF+ TOUR, or go head to head in Battle mode.

{1635943166960181}

✅ Real Golf Brands: Experience golf equipment from leading brands like Callaway, TaylorMade, and PXG.

{558130397145170}
📈 Performance Feedback: Advanced shot stats, strokes gained data, handicap system, and swing analyzer to help you understand and improve your game.

🎯 Diverse Modes: From Match Play to Skins, Weekly Challenges and Topgolf, we have an experience for every player.

🏞 GOLF+ Clubhouse: A place to practice, fine tune your clubs, and play fun mini-games.

🖥 Media Player: Seamlessly enjoy YouTube and other web media right on the course.

New Update v774.6

## New Feature: Store Redesign + Golf Bags
We’ve overhauled the store with a new design and loads of customization options! Explore new ways to personalize your GOLF+ experience.

## Expanded Club Options
- Club Swapping: Customize your bag like never before by replacing your 3 or 4 iron with other clubs, such as hybrids or woods, to better suit your play style.
- 7 Woods: We've added a club to your arsenal for more set-up options.
- More Wedges: Fine-tune your short game with additional wedge options, offering new lofts for improved gapping.
- New Drivers: 8 and 11 degree driver variations (9.5 degree is current standard)
- More Hybrids: 5 hybrids (previously 3 hybrid was the only type of hybrid)
- 3 Wood: A 16.5 degree "high launch" 3 Wood
- New club models like the Callaway Ai Smoke and more.

## Golf Bags
Bags are here! Buy, equip, and show off your new bag on the course. Golf bags add a new way to personalize your style.

## Other Updates:
Media Player
- Websites would become permanently zoomed out when entering Giant Mode.
- The Web/YouTube player became zoomed out if you 'Reset' the Media Player.
- Issues with the keyboard and website fields becoming disengaged.
- Spotify fix.

Challenges
- The UI would show an incorrect yardage the first time loading in.

New Update v773.1

## New Course: Te Arai Links - South Course
Located on the stunning east coast of New Zealand’s North Island, Te Arai Links is one of golf’s newest must-see destinations.
The South Course, a traditional links-style design by Coore & Crenshaw, features 16 holes with breathtaking ocean views, including eight that sit directly along the sea.
Discover why this masterpiece has quickly earned its place among the world’s top courses.Performance Improvements - We have had a Quest 2 specific beta going over this last week specific to performance improvements.

## Performance Updates

### Quest 2 Only Update
Course Optimization - LOD Texture Updates (Level of Detail)
Courses that are performant heavy have received an updated resolution treatment. Now, only the hole you are on will be in normal resolution, while the other holes around you will be in low resolution. Other holes will update if your shot lands there, or you teleport there when exploring.

### Quest 2 and 3 Updates
1. CPU Updates - Focused on club hitting ball and all that happens during and right before - smoothing out the club impact sequence. All sounds and effects around hitting a shot have been refactored to not interfere with the main action, club hitting the ball.  Shots should 'feel' much cleaner, especially the pitches, touchy shots and chipping.
2. GOLF+ Tour - A big tournament specific performance update. Tournament play is much smoother, in line with regular rounds.
3. Courses are running at about 15% more performant.
4. ‘Dead shots' caused by frame drops - Impact timing updates to protect against frame drops.
5. Courses without crowds -  Fixed a bug causing a performance degradation when going out of bounds.

### Courses with Additional Performance Optimizations:
- Canyons
- Castle Pines
- Muirfield

## Additional Quality and Bug Fixes:
- [Customization] Some players seeing incorrect store cost and clubs defaulting back to original clubs after equipping
- [Challenges] Restarting a challenge, the lie type will be the prior attempts 'restart' lie type
- [MP] When playing lefty w/ right controller, clubs are seen as reversed for other players
- [MP] Replay mid round would cause the game to lock-up in a 2 player MP game
- [Battle] Players could hit a bug starting the battle on the 2nd hole
- [UI] When using the 'hide menu' option it is impossible to see wind speeds
- [UI] 'Invalid Drop' pill renders over main menu if cursor pointed at main menu
- [GOLF+ Tour] Loss of wi-fi round posting DNF
- [Course - Hay Putting] 2 player MP, standard turns - 2nd player to go to the next tee box could be placed too far away.

## Remaining G+ TOUR Fall Schedule
11/21 - 11/27: The Ocean Course at Kiawah Island
11/28 - 12/4: Week 1 of Playoffs at Mystery Course???
* Weekly and Daily Tournaments this week will earn 2x Points
12/5 - 12/11: Week 2 of Playoffs at Lofoten Links
* Weekly and Daily Tournaments this week will earn 3x Points

New Update v772.1

New Course: Jumeirah Earth Course

The home of the DP World Tour Championship, The Earth Course at Jumeirah Golf Estates offers a one-of-a-kind golfing experience set amidst the vibrant cityscape of Dubai. 
The closing stretch, known as the "Great Finish," is particularly notable for its dramatic and visually stunning variety of holes.

Bug Fixes:
- Battle mode - Playoffs - Player's shot must be in play for it to count.
- Battle mode - Leaderboard properly updates when changing the difficulty on the main UI.
- Battle Mode - Settings would initially be shown wrong on the main UI when going into first Battle.
- G+ TOUR - Addressed more edge cases where you could potentially receive a DNF.
- Replays - Viewing a replay from profile or top shots mid round would cause player to be stuck, forcing them to restart the round.
- Topgolf - Leaderboard view fix.

Remaining G+ TOUR Fall Schedule
11/7 - 11/13: Canyons
11/14 - 11/20: Jumeirah Earth Course
11/21 - 11/27: The Ocean Course at Kiawah Island
11/28 - 12/4: Week 1 of Playoffs at Mystery Course???
* Weekly and Daily Tournaments this week will earn 2x Points
12/5 - 12/11: Week 2 of Playoffs at Lofoten Links
* Weekly and Daily Tournaments this week will earn 3x Points

New Update v771.2 is Live!

## New Course: Canyons
Introducing Canyons, a GOLF+ original design where you'll navigate dramatic elevation changes and face a series of thrilling risk-reward holes.
Set against a rustic canyon backdrop, and inspired by old western mining towns, each hole presents a new, exhilarating challenge that will test even the most seasoned golfers.

## New HD User Interface
- A new menu look, as well as HD treatment to all interactive and visual screens.
* Quest 2 players will have the main menu HD off by default. Same as in live currently, turning it on in the settings will have a performance hit. With it off, the main menu will be standard definition when you have a club in hand to hit, and will change to HD when have controller in hand to interact with menu.

## Sweetens Cove 10th Anniversary Major
- The GOLF+ Tour will head to Sweetens Cove on 10/31 for the Major of the season. The weekly tournament will have a 3x Points Multiplier. No multiplier for daily tournaments. 

## No Laying Up - Hole In One Challenge
In partnership with 'No Laying Up', Challenges the week of 10/28 on Sweetens Cove will have a Hole In One contest.
- Everyone who completes the Hole-in-One challenge will unlock Sweetens Cove.
- 5 Players with a HIO will receive a $100 Credit to the No Laying Up Pro Shop.
- 4 G+ Pass members with a HIO will win a Day Pass to Sweetens Cove - In real life ; )
* Must have a GOLF+ email account to be eligible. GOLF+ PASS trial members eligible. Contest rules at www.golfplusvr.com/terms-and-conditions apply.

## New Update v770.02

## New Course: Lofoten Links

Ranked as the #24 golf course in the world by Golf Digest, Lofoten Links is located in the Arctic Circle of Norway and is one of the most unique and breathtaking courses you will find. In the summer months, golfers have the rare opportunity to play under the Midnight Sun - or witness the Northern Lights during the cooler seasons.

## Scramble Update

- You can now change captaincy at any time during a round.

### Unrestricted Hit Order for Teams

- Unrestricted Hit Order allows any player on a team to hit at anytime after the Captain selects the shot. 
- *Note: Unrestricted Hit Order is only for Hit Order within teams. The team furthest from the hole will still be up first.

### Update to Standard Team Order

- Player now has the ability to 'Defer Shot' to the next player, moving them to the back of the hit order.

## Bug Fixes

- Edge case where clubs could change length when teleporting while in Giant Mode.
- The "Hide the flag on the green" setting was not working properly.
- Scramble mode - If someone rejoined on the Back 9, players could get stuck in a turn, forcing everyone to leave the round.
- GOLF+ Tour - Fixed an issue where the last hole of a round would not get counted right away, showing a DNF to the player, until it updated later on.

New Update v769.0

GOLF+ Pass Fall Sale! 37% Off Annual Subscription for the first year.

Bug Fixes:
- Battle ELO reset & mode optimizations
- Fixed distance tip over ball that would not show up after hole 1 on tee shots.
- Fixed replays on Scramble rounds from showing the 'shot select' screen.
- GOLF+ Tour - Non course owners could hit a black screen upon round resume.

Course Updates:
Pinehurst - Fixed multiple tee markers showing on some holes.
Quail Hollow - Hole 16 - Fixed the large grandstand not giving players TIO relief.
Kiawah - Addressed some lighting on the Clubhouse and bulkheads.
Kapalua - Addressed some lighting and branding on the grandstands.

Other Updates:
- Updated 'How To' Videos in the Media Player, under 'Help'.

New Update v768.03

New Course: The Hay

The Hay 9-Hole Par-3 Course
- The Hay is a 9-hole par-3 course located at the Pebble Beach Resort offering a fun and accessible environment for players of all skill levels. Each hole is crafted to blend seamlessly with the natural beauty of Pebble Beach to showcase stunning ocean views.

Included! The Hay 18-Hole Putting Course
- In addition to its par-3 course, The Hay features an 18-hole putting course that provides an enjoyable and challenging experience for players of all skill levels.

Performance improvements
We've been diligently working to improve performance across our game, and this build marks the first phase of that effort. It includes enhancements aimed at boosting frame rates on all courses. This is just the first step in our continued effort and there will be more to come. This won't be a one-and-done fix but rather a series of incremental steps over time to bring you all a much smoother experience.
- Note - this first round is focused on gameplay performance, not course specific performance, but thru this effort, it directly affects performance on courses.

Bug Fixes:
- Updated the 'Smart' club selection setting from giving the player a 3W instead of Driver in certain instances.
- Fixed an issue where transitioning between Quickplay and Tournaments could result in a broken state.

New Update v767.4 

VR FedExCup Playoffs Update:
- Added badges and trophies, with the ability to hold and inspect them. Available after the VR TOUR Championship.
- Updated tournament end summary for VR TOUR Championship.

Bug Fixes:
- Players would not being able to resume their tournament round, resulting in a DNF, on courses they did not own.
- Scramble rounds would become stuck if an opposing player leaves the round, and rejoins after the other team completes the hole.

Course Updates:
East Lake Golf Club - Cleaned up the waters edge around the sewer drain on Hole 1 and adjusted the OB line on the left side of Hole 7.
Castle Pines - Hole 16 - Fixed a gap in the rock wall around the green that allowed the ball to fall thru if it came to rest there.

New Update v766.91

New Course: East Lake Golf Club - Renovated Version

Receive both the pre and post-renovated East Lake Golf Club for the price of one!

The new-look East Lake Golf Club will make its first public appearance at the 2024 TOUR Championship. Led by Andrew Green - coined as “golf’s new hottest architect” by Golf Digest - the project began immediately following the 2023 TOUR Championship with the goal of restoring the iconic property to its early 20th century roots. The most notable changes to the course are reflected in the topography, greens and bunkers to allow the course to play both firmer and faster. Streams and ponds were also a primary focus to bring back the native habitat and have water play as a more punishing hazard.

**PLEASE NOTE**: Purchasing the post renovation East Lake Golf Club will also grant the pre-renovated East Lake for free. If you already own the original East Lake, you will automatically receive the post renovated East Lake for free. In game, the new version will be 'East Lake Golf Club' and the pre-renovated version will be 'East Lake 2023'.

Course Updates:
Cliffs - Cleaned up some 'triangles' on the course that would show on the Map interface
Castle Pines - Cleaned up some lines within the skybox and fixed a seam between fairway and rough on Hole 13

New Update v765.16

New Course: Castle Pines

Colorado's stunning Castle Pines Golf Club is set to host the top 50 players at the 2024 BMW Championship, the penultimate event of PGA TOUR's FedExCup Playoffs. 
Designed by Jack Nicklaus, this private club set against the backdrop of the majestic Rocky Mountains features drastic elevation changes, towering pine trees and native wildlife. 
Castle Pines is a mainstay in Golf Digest's Top 50 Greatest Courses in America list and is proudly home of "The Best Day of Golf in America."

Elevation Update:
Ball flight physics have been updated for all courses in-game to take course elevation into account. 
In higher elevation courses the ball flies further. This change only applies to Physics V2.

Bug Fixes:
- Media Player keyboard not working in text fields of websites.
- A crash could occur when accepting a Topgolf invite while on the Quickplay start UI.

New Update v764.0

VR FedExCup Playoff Branding:
- Updated all tee markers, flags and hospitality tents with new branding.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where players would see another player's dust effect on their ball in MP.
- Addressed web crashes that could occur when changing scenes.
- Addressed web crashes that could occur when filtering thru leaderboards.

New Update v763.05

**New Game Mode: Scramble**
Experience team golf like never before with Scramble. In Scramble, players can play together in teams of 2, 3 or 4 golfers with each player hitting their tee shot, and then the team deciding what shot to play from next. Continue this process until someone on the team holes a putt. Scramble teams can also compete against each other in 2v1, 3v1 or 2v2 formats.

Other Updates:
- Multiplayer - Updated player head and ball tips.
- Multiplayer - you can now see other players shots on the main course UI.

Quality and Bug Fixes:
- Ability to accept an MP game invite while in the 'game mode' select screen.
- Match Play and Skins had no concede sound playing before scorecard appeared.

Course fixes:
- Lighting on Wolf Creek clubhouse
- Lighting on Houses off Sawgrass Hole 10
- Out of bounds update on Bay Hill

New Update v762.40

New Course: Sweetens Cove Golf Club

Beautiful. Strategic. Fun. Sweetens Cove, a masterpiece crafted by visionary designers Rob Collins and Tad King, epitomizes the essence of modern golf. Nestled in the foothills of Appalachia, just 30 minutes from Chattanooga, Tennessee, its unique nine-hole, 18-pin routing ensures endless variety and challenge for each hole. There’s no lavish clubhouse or driving range—just a trailer, a few carts, and a playground for golfers to unleash their imagination and creativity.

Quality Updates and Bug Fixes:
- Closest To The Pin - Entering this mode from another mode would show your previous lie in the course screen.
- Tournaments - Leaving a tournament round on Hole 1 would not offer you a resume tournament and result in a DNF.
- If you did not update the app to the latest version, trying to start a Tournament Round or Challenge on a newly released course would cause a soft crash. Now you will not be allowed to start and will be prompted to update the app. 
- Fixed the G+ Credit balance from showing too many decimal places in your Profile.
- Updated Quickplay to remember the Green Speed from your last played session.
- Holding side trigger or raising the club to see the UI above the hole, will now show 'Wrong Pin' on courses with greens that have 2 holes.
- Giant Mode positioning updates.

Course Updates: Spyglass
- Tee Markers now have collision.
- Hole 9: Aligned a tree model to not interfere with tee shots.
- Hole 14: Adjusted the OB on the left side of the fairway.
- Hole 16: Fixed a stake that was floating on the left side of green.

New Update v761.2

New Course: Spyglass Hill

Just a few miles north of the iconic Pebble Beach Golf Links, Spyglass Hill is celebrated as the toughest test on the Monterey Peninsula. Crafted by renowned designer Robert Trent Jones Sr., this course boasts a unique dual personality. The first five holes play along the coastal dunes, offering breathtaking Pacific Ocean views, before transitioning into the serene and challenging Del Monte Forest. Known affectionately as "Spy," this course co-hosts the prestigious AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am on the PGA TOUR.

Bug Fixes & Quality Updates:

- The course settings 'holes selection' would not reset to 'Full 18' after playing Butler Pitch and Putt.
- A specific UX flow would prevent players from entering Butler Pitch and Putt in Quick Play mode.
- A navigation issue in Challenges where the top menu bar back arrow wouldn't appear after going to another mode.
- In Clubhouse practice mode, when tapping 'new ball', the new ball was not lined up towards the hole.
- Updated green fringe physics.

**New Update v760.17**

**⛳ New Course: Butler Pitch and Putt ⛳**

Butler Pitch and Putt is a historic 9-hole, par-3 golf course which has been a cultural staple in downtown Austin, Texas since 1949. Just a quick 10 minute drive from our headquarters, with holes ranging from 60 to 105 yards, Butler operates on a first-come, first-play basis—no tee times, just drop a ball into the chute to claim your spot. Home of the Tito's Shorties Classic and supporting partner of Save Muny and Youth On Course, Butler Pitch and Putt truly embodies the spirit of making golf accessible and enjoyable for all.

Butler is an example of golf at its best: it's fun, it doesn't take itself too seriously, and it is welcoming to everyone. We've enjoyed rounds at Butler with first time golfers & seasoned vets, humans & dogs, and people wearing golf shoes, flip-flops & cowboy boots. We’re excited that Butler stands shoulder-to-shoulder with many of the world’s best courses in GOLF+.

Please explore this playground of a course, and keep an eye out for all the small details scattered about. The scoreboard behind the putting green for Aces and Low Round is always live, so be sure to dial in your pitch game!

Patch v759.04

Bug Fixes & Quality Updates:
- Fixed an issue starting a Tournament or Practice Round causing an infinite loading screen.
- Another fix for audio loss.
